question: The actor's performance in a ___________ plays is completely speechless, the story is enacted using a vocabulary of facial expressions and hand-gestures.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **actor's performance in a Kathakali plays is completely speechless** the 'libretto' is sung by two singers on the stage who keep time on gong and cymbals, while a pair of drummers also on the stage play the Chenda.
 
• It is characterized by:
 
 
• **Speechless performance:** The story is enacted without spoken words.
 
• **Facial expressions and hand gestures:** A rich vocabulary of **mudras** (hand gestures) and **abhinaya** (facial expressions) are used to convey the narrative.
 
• **Elaborate costumes and makeup:** These enhance the visual storytelling.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• **Originates from Tamil Nadu considered one of the most expressive classical dance forms.**
 
• **Known for its combination of nritta** (pure dance), nritya (expressive dance), and Natya (dramatic storytelling).
 
 
 
• **Odissi Dance**
 
 
• Originates from **Odisha and is one of the oldest classical dance forms.**
 
• **Known for its lyrical movements** and depiction of spiritual themes from the Vaishnavite tradition, particularly about Lord Jagannath and stories from the Gita Govinda.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri Dance**
 
 
• Originates from Manipur in northeastern India.
 
• **Known for its soft, graceful movements **and storytelling through expressions and mudras (hand gestures).
 
• Focuses on themes from Vaishnavism, particularly stories of Radha and Krishna.
